items.summary: Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) announced on Tuesday that it expanded its Agentic Ready program to include merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers and commerce platforms, helping them prepare for transactions initiated by AI agents. The initiative, part of Visa Intelligent Commerce, launched with more than 140 participants, including Adyen, Antom, Billtrust, Checkout.com, Fiserv, Global Payments, PayPal and Stripe. items.summary: Visa (NYSE:V) has expanded its Agentic Ready programme to include merchants, payment processors, acquiring banks and commerce platforms, extending its efforts to support transactions initiated by artificial intelligence agents.
